concepts.quote: Every name must be a full word, so i must be index and c must be count.
concepts.why: The answer treats 'every name must be a full word' as a binding rule, but Java has no such rule, i is the accepted name for a short loop index, so only c needed renaming, and the answer never says whether the output changes.
The answer names variables to rename but says nothing correct or incorrect about what a variable is or how it behaves.
The answer says nothing about compile-time errors.
